description: Canonical enum source for algorithm classification fields (industries, techniques, difficulty, computation_model). Every algorithm.json is validated against this in CI. v2 cleaned up overlap: removed 'optimization' and 'education' from industries (replaced by foundational + technique facets); removed 'vqa' from techniques (replaced by vqe/qaoa families); added 'qml' and 'mbqc'.

foundational.label: Foundational / Quantum Primitives
foundational.description: Quantum primitives without a specific applied domain. bell-state, ghz-state, teleportation, swap-test, deutsch-jozsa, qft, etc. Educational use is signaled via difficulty=beginner, not by industry.

finance.label: Finance & Banking
finance.description: Portfolio optimization, option pricing, risk analysis, credit scoring.

chemistry.label: Chemistry & Molecular
chemistry.description: Molecular simulation, ground state energy, reaction pathways.

materials.label: Materials Science
materials.description: Band structure, lattice models, condensed matter simulation.

pharma.label: Pharma & Healthcare
pharma.description: Drug discovery, molecular docking, protein folding.

logistics.label: Logistics & Supply Chain
logistics.description: Vehicle routing, job scheduling, supply chain optimization. Optimization problems live here, not in a separate 'optimization' industry.

cryptography.label: Cryptography & Security
cryptography.description: QKD protocols, quantum random number generation, PQC demonstrations.

ml.label: Quantum Machine Learning
ml.description: Quantum kernels, classifiers, generative models, feature maps, linear-system solvers (HHL).

energy.label: Energy & Sustainability
energy.description: Grid optimization, battery simulation, carbon capture modeling.

telecom.label: Telecommunications
telecom.description: Network optimization, channel coding, resource allocation.

gate.label: Gate-Based Circuit
gate.description: Pure gate-based, non-variational. grover, qft, deutsch-jozsa, bernstein-vazirani, simons, swap-test, hadamard-test, qpe.

vqe.label: VQE
vqe.description: Variational quantum eigensolver family. vqe-h2, vqe-beh2, vqe-h2o, vqe-bond-scan, vqe-hubbard.

qaoa.label: QAOA
qaoa.description: Quantum approximate optimization algorithm family. qaoa-maxcut, qaoa-tsp, qaoa-portfolio, graph-coloring.

annealing.label: Quantum Annealing
annealing.description: Quantum annealing on QUBO/Ising problems. annealing-maxcut, annealing-jobshop, protein-folding (annealing form).

analog.label: Analog Hamiltonian Simulation
analog.description: Continuous Hamiltonian evolution, Trotterization. trotter-ising, time-evolution.

qec.label: Quantum Error Correction
qec.description: Error correcting codes, syndrome decoding, fault tolerance. bit-flip-code, phase-flip-code, shor-code, steane-code, surface-code.

qml.label: Quantum Machine Learning
qml.description: Quantum-native ML techniques: qsvm, quantum-kernel, quantum-autoencoder.

classical.label: Classical Baseline
classical.description: Classical solvers shipped for comparison: exact-diag, brute-force, random-sampler.

gate.label: Gate-Based
gate.description: Discrete gate quantum circuit. Default for VQE, QAOA, and most algorithms.

annealing.label: Quantum Annealing
annealing.description: QUBO/Ising adiabatic problems. D-Wave and SA simulators.

analog.label: Analog
analog.description: Continuous Hamiltonian evolution (Rydberg arrays, Trotterized simulation).

classical.label: Classical Baseline
classical.description: Classical solver shipped for comparison (exact diag, brute-force, tensor networks). Runs on CPU; not quantum hardware.

industries.optimization: Was an industry, but optimization is a technique flavor (qaoa/annealing) applied across finance, logistics, etc. Use those industries + technique tags.
industries.education: Was an industry, but educational use is an audience signal (difficulty=beginner), not an application domain. Foundational/primitive algorithms now live in industry=foundational.

techniques.vqa: Was an umbrella tag mixing VQE and QAOA. Use the specific family (vqe or qaoa). UI groupings 'all variational' derive from the union.
